name: Gaol of Khazarad
desc1: This grim stone structure is seldom used for anything serious-- the
desc2: dwarves often fight amongst themselves, but rarely beyond fisticuffs.
desc3: Mainly drunk brawlers show up here, to be released when their heads
desc4: clear. A heavy wooden desk against one wall is there for the duty
desc5: officer to wait at, and the hall towards the lockup is to the north.
